_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A blank new-conversation recording gets a saved return target. The test seeded a conversation {{VIEWED}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). Call "draftCreated" says ("true" or "false") whether the browser's first draft creation (POST /api/conversations/draft) has been answered and, once it has, sets {{DRAFT}} to the conversation it created; call "draftResponse" reports that answer's status and the "draft" field of its request as JSON. Recording uploads are counted by call "uploads". The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and click the voice button.
2. Call "draftCreated" should return "true" within 10s.
3. Call "draftResponse" must return exactly {"status":201,"draft":""}.
4. The URL should end with "/c/{{DRAFT}}".
5. The recording panel should be visible. Mark it: eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"recording-panel\"]').setAttribute('data-instance-marker', 'blank-new')".
6. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The recorder should float, and the voice button should be disabled.
7. Click [data-testid="recording-return-button"]. The URL should end with "/c/{{DRAFT}}".
8. Exactly one recording panel should exist (count 1), and it should still have data-instance-marker "blank-new", and the recorder should not float.
9. Click the cancel button. Call "uploads" must return "0".
